expected: 'Confirm reservation' receives visible keyboard focus in Tab order after 'Edit meeting name' (and in Shift+Tab reverse order) and activates with Enter and Space to produce the confirmed reservation, like other primary booking controls.
limitations: No browser execution available in this session; Tab order and Enter/Space activation verified by code inspection only, not by live keyboard run.
Whether a pointer click on the span worked was not tested; fix assumes the click handler path is preserved.
preserve: Pricing, room filtering, projector/service fee totals, and pointer booking paths
Visible layout and styling of the review page and primary button
Existing successful keyboard paths: room selection, meeting-name entry, and earlier steps
problem: On the Review page, 'Confirm reservation' is a span with tabindex="-1" and role="button" (app.js review()), so Tab/Shift+Tab never land on it and Enter/Space cannot activate it; keyboard-only users cannot complete the booking at the final step.
title: Make Confirm reservation a keyboard-focusable native button

criteria.description: 'Confirm reservation' on the Review page is a natively focusable control in the sequential Tab order (no tabindex="-1", no non-focusable span).
criteria.source: finding-210d2e86-9bd6-4376-8cda-e94c8d60a42c-0 observation (Tab skipped Confirm, Shift+Tab returned to Edit meeting name) and charter expectation that required booking controls receive keyboard focus

criteria.description: 'Confirm reservation' shows visible focus and activates with Enter and Space to confirm the reservation.
criteria.source: finding expectation: control should activate with standard keys like 'Choose Atlas' and 'Review booking'; charter success criterion of keyboard-only completion
